D1.rationale: Session JSONL records every call as separate tool/call + tool/result events with args and results; T2 complete for calls made (agent pre-created the directory); no coverage assertion.

D2.rationale: Events carry seq/time but no signatures; no verification story for the record.

D3.rationale: Strictly increasing seq bound to every event (verified T1: 35 events) plus per-event time: explicit total order. No cryptographic linkage (not 2).

D4.rationale: All events sit under a session header carrying a session id and createdAt - a stable run identifier bound to the record.

D5.rationale: Fixture secret in cleartext x7; the only redaction text in the repo is a deferred note about future UI exposure of settings secrets - no record redaction mechanism.
